parts.text:
You are shepherding PR #865 through CI to merge.

Repository: anchapin/nexus-proxy
PR: https://github.com/anchapin/nexus-proxy/pull/865
Branch: fix/issue-831-blocked-counter
Workdir: /home/alex/AI/worktrees/issue-831-blocked-counter

Steps:
1. Check CI status: gh pr checks 865
2. IF CI is green:
   a. Check mergeable: gh pr view 865 --json mergeable
   b. If CONFLICTING → follow the merge conflict protocol
   c. If MERGEABLE → merge: gh pr merge 865 --squash --delete-branch
      Verify: gh pr view 865 --json mergedAt --jq '.mergedAt'
      If null after retry → report BLOCKED
   d. Clean up: git worktree remove ../worktrees/issue-831-blocked-counter
3. IF CI is failing:
   a. gh run list --branch fix/issue-831-blocked-counter --limit 1
   b. gh run view <RUN_ID> --log
   c. Apply minimal fix in the worktree
   d. git add -A && git commit -m "fix: resolve CI failure" && git push
   e. Wait for CI (poll every 30s, max 10 iterations)
   f. If still failing → report blocker and STOP
4. IF merge conflict:
   a. git fetch origin develop && git rebase origin/develop
   b. Auto-resolve; if unresolvable → STOP and report
   c. git push --force-with-lease origin fix/issue-831-blocked-counter
   d. Re-trigger CI

Report back: final status (MERGED / BLOCKED / CONFLICT), iterations used.
Let me start by checking the CI status for PR #865.

The stack trace shows this happens at `registry_test.go:325`, which is inside the loop where it's trying to register the same provider name repeatedly. The benchmark is clearly broken—it should either register once before the timer starts, or use unique names for each iteration.

reg := NewProviderRegistry()
reg.Register(ProviderConfig{NameVal: "provider", ...})
b.ResetTimer()
for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {

}
